data.summary: **Pets & Animals, Entertainment, Howto & Style** lead the top 30 trending youtube clips in ALL, across **3 theme(s)**. Each is clustered from the real feed with its most likely root cause — treat the drivers as **hypotheses**, not proven causation.

themes.title: Pets & Animals surge
themes.content_type: short clips clustered around the Pets & Animals category
themes.observed_pattern: **9 of the top clips** fall in Pets & Animals; they share a **format**, not a single sound.
themes.root_cause: A broad audience-interest spike is concentrating watch-time on this kind of content.
themes.why_now: The youtube algorithm is currently amplifying this cluster in ALL, so similar uploads compound on each other.
themes.what_to_create: Make a Pets & Animals clip in the dominant format with the **payoff in the first second**.

action_plan.suggested_format: single-take vertical clip, on-screen text stating the payoff up front
action_plan.hook_line: This is why this clip will not leave your feed.
action_plan.angle: the one specific outcome people in this category keep coming back to watch
action_plan.cta: Ask viewers to save it if they want to find the format again later.

themes.caveat: These 9 clips share a category but **no single event or sound** — could be steady Pets & Animals interest, not a spike.
